about: Round 3 (fix/needle-allowlist) clinical-safety regression corpus. Every phrase is invented and synthetic: no real patient, no recording.
Each entry is dictated text (one or more sentences) and `expect`: the only medication or vital fields that may ever be clean (act or provisional).
An empty `expect` means every medication or vital field from the text must be needs review (a correction, a range, a count, a condition, a second drug or dose, an ambiguous spoken number, and so on).

Medication fields: med (drug as said), dose (the normalizer's display), freq (its display), route (PO, IV, IM, SC, SL, inhaled, topical; default unknown), status (taking, started, stopped, considering).
Vital fields: vital (BP, HR, RR, SpO2, temp) and value (the normalizer's display).
Voice entries give `copied`: the one acceptable text when a command is applied. Otherwise the text must be left unchanged and marked (`VoiceCommandResult.unresolved`).

Sources: rr1 = fix-needle-rereview.md (round-1 re-review); rr2 = fix-needle2-rereview.md (round-2 adversarial table, row numbers); probe = the round-2 reviewer's probe files (rr2probe/*.txt); l3 = l3-needle-review.md (the first review); eval = eval-soap-meds.v1.json; ordinary = the round-2 reviewer's 30-sentence ordinary dictation.
